verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say models run on llama.cpp and that local GGUF files can be imported, so it loads one quantization-oriented container format. Nothing in the evidence mentions FP8, GPTQ, AWQ, or explicit INT4 quantization levels, so only a narrow slice of the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented support for FP8, GPTQ and AWQ formats; explicit quantization-level selection (e.g., INT4); independent or hands-on corroboration of loading quantized models.
